Restart delay\n \n \n

\n
Restart max attempts\n \n \n

\n
Restart window\n \n \n

\n Time window to evaluate restart attempts expressed by a number followed by unit (ns|us|ms|s|m|h). Default value is 0 seconds, which is unbounded.\n
